title: Grapefizz Bhuna Chicken Tacos
description: A twist on traditional Indian bhuna recipes, this Mexican-inspired dish combines grapefizz marinated chicken with the spices of bhuna sauce, served in tacos.
instructions: Marinate the chicken in grapefizz, cumin, chili powder, and salt for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook until browned and cooked through.
Add the bhuna sauce to the skillet and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a simmer.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a piece of cooked chicken onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of the bhuna sauce.
If desired, top with shredded cheese and serve immediately.
